title: knittogether 0.1.5.2
text: placeholder_prefix now used exactly given, default "placeholder_". placeholder prefix followed ID, nothing added : "placeholder_" ID plot gives placeholder_plot, "xyz_" gives xyz_plot. Previously underscore always added default "placeholder_content". keep using placeholder_content_plot, pass placeholder_prefix = "placeholder_content_". affects clean_markdown(), replace_placeholders() run_workflow().

title: knittogether 0.1.5.2
text: Help pages rewritten plain language. Arguments shared clean_markdown() replace_placeholders() documented inherited. Internal helpers longer get help pages. Every exported function @return, content PowerPoint helpers examples run. pkgdown reference page grouped workflow, defining content, versions, PowerPoint, output format, checking long documents. README vignettes rewritten plainer language, topic explained one place. README gives pitch, installation short example. getting-started vignette now one place explains terms (placeholder, marker, draft block), round trip Word, final render keeping versions. vignettes link instead repeating . Fixed errors vignettes: broken include shortcode links getting started; example blocks extended-workflow PowerPoint vignettes knitr ran instead displaying; create_base_files() failing render default; include workflow/example.qmd, file never created. run_workflow() docs now say unrecognised arguments error, ignored.

title: knittogether 0.1.5
text: convert() now convert_markdown() clean() now clean_markdown() split() now split_markdown() replace() now replace_placeholders() ## Bug fixes %||% now imported rlang, package longer needs R >= 4.4.0 without declaring . tools now listed Imports. auto_slide_break() longer loops forever section starts heading longer limit. insert_slide_break() now ignores heading start text choosing break. replace_placeholders() matches placeholder whole word handles longer slugs first, placeholder_content_plot longer overwrites part placeholder_content_plot_2, marker already inserted. replace_placeholders() gives copy chunk placeholder label (plot, plot_2, …). Previously placeholder used twice produced duplicate labels, stops knitr. as_child, child_dir engine longer written chunk headers. Inline child chunks now share one header builder. clean_markdown(clear_placeholder_styling = TRUE) (default) now unwraps spans contain placeholder token. previously collapsed whitespace every line, flattened nested lists, code grid tables removed hard line breaks, deleted every {custom-style="..."} attribute document. Heading offsets, PowerPoint section offsets, slide-break background-header processing now treat real Markdown headings headings (space #s, outside fenced code YAML). Previously #| echo: false # comment lines inside code chunks edited. is_pdf() now detects PDF output (always returned FALSE). hide_markers_css() targets data-custom-style, attribute Pandoc writes HTML, hidden markers actually hidden. run_workflow() now errors unrecognised unnamed arguments. Previously misspelt argument heading_ofset = TRUE silently ignored. clean_markdown() removes Word formatting (superscript, subscript, bold, italic) sits tight placeholder, formatting longer wrapped round code output (PHDAT-1198). convert_markdown() now defaults pandoc_version = "default". default Pandoc missing older 3.8.3, Pandoc bundled RStudio/Positron Quarto meets 3.8.3 used. Start-checks use logic. clean_markdown() also removes U+27E6 / U+27E7 brackets example template puts around placeholders, superscript subscript formatting placeholders carry Word. test runs example docx convert clean (PHDAT-1198). clean_markdown() longer errors documents without example template’s bracket characters. patterns used \x{...} escapes PCRE rejects non-UTF-8 text. Draft markers default DRAFT_CONTENT_START DRAFT_CONTENT_END instead --DRAFT_CONTENT-- --END_DRAFT_CONTENT--, Word turns -- dash markers found re-import. Documents written old markers must replaced running clean_markdown(). draft_mode still defaults TRUE. replace_placeholders() docs now state marker_mode = "" writes marker content inserted way can’t refreshed re-import. extended-workflow vignette shows pre-render step builds markdown Quarto render (PHDAT-1199, PHDAT-1004). replace_placeholders(draft_mode = FALSE) now removes draft markers left earlier draft pass, output none final render can run straight draft. Draft blocks placeholder marker left alone. define_content() works without description content_type. top-level { } block unwrapped every value prints chunk. content can passed function injected !!, example inside lapply(). split_markdown() gives section subfolder one output_dir supplied, sections longer overwrite one output.md. Repeated headings get -2, -3, … folder names. Content first split point saved split_preamble.md instead dropped. Titles containing quotes backslashes escaped YAML header. package now depends R >= 4.4.0 (base %||%) rather importing %||% rlang. README quick start following workflow poster (writer adds placeholders, coder fills R, writer edits, coder re-imports, final render), terms placeholder, marker draft block. latest_word_file() finds recently saved .docx .pptx folder, optionally base name, ignoring Word lock files. timestamped_path() adds time stamp output name never overwritten (PHDAT-1200). convert_markdown(), clean_markdown() replace_placeholders() take overwrite. overwrite = FALSE stop rather write existing file. clean_markdown() replace_placeholders() also take output_file, writes result somewhere else leaves input unchanged. default still overwrites, existing scripts behave . run_workflow() takes folder input_file uses newest Word PowerPoint file, optionally restricted base_name. step now reads previous step’s output, output_file clean_markdown() replace_placeholders() fills. clean_markdown(clear_draft = TRUE) needs placeholder_prefix used fill draft. Documented README extended workflow vignette.
